result:
Round 191 is planned: it fixes Saba's fader bug, SABA-B-3. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and no app source was changed.

**Round 190 result:** C passed it, with the browser checks run and real. All 16 rows passed and no bugs were found. Root published rounds 189 and 190 as commit `338564e`, which is the baseline for round 191.
- STORE-1d and therefore all of STORE-1 are now **მზადაა**.
- C-R189-01 (the loader's layout shift) and C-R189-02 (Tab under the loader) are closed.
- I updated the backlog only from that evidence.

**Round 191 task (D-29z156): the fader turns into a brass box when pressed (Medium).**
- **Why now:** Saba asked for it to be fixed next. The 3-day regression round is not due until 2026-10-27; today is 10-26. The round-190 task predicted that round 191 would be the regression round, and that no longer holds.
- **Reproduction:** I reproduced it in the browser, and it matches Saba's screenshot. On a mouse press the 2 px brass ring adds to the site-wide brass outline in `app.css`. That outline still appears even though the fader's classes ask for none. Together they form a brass band. A confirms the cause first, in step K0.
- **R68:** the four faders Saba named (track, group, Master, Clip Gain) get a graphite track, a brass value fill and the normal ivory thumb, in every state.
- **R69:** all six sliders show one thin brass focus ring, offset from the control, that never crosses the thumb.
- **R70:** Pan and Zoom have the same bug but get only the ring fix; their look stays neutral.
- **R71:** the styles live in one new shared file, `studio-fader.ts`.
- **Files:** A may edit 6 existing files and create 3 new ones (the shared style file, a new test and implementation doc 157). The other 1013 files are frozen, including the auth files and `app.css`.
- **C's checks:** C checks each slider at 1440 and 1280 in five states (rest, pressed, dragging, released, keyboard focus) with pixel measurements. It also checks that dragging, fine drag, reset and Undo still work, that the volume really changes what you hear, that the layout doesn't shift, and that the store pages are unchanged and sign-in protection still holds. C also runs the new tests against deliberately broken versions of the code to confirm they catch the bug.

**Decisions for Saba to confirm or veto:**
- R68 also changes how those four faders look at rest: the fill goes from ivory to brass. This replaces the earlier neutral-fill decision (DUX-R-5b-1) for those four faders only.
- The fix reaches slightly beyond the four faders he named: Pan and the Zoom slider in the transport bar have the same bug, so they get the ring fix too.

**Also recorded:**
- **Queue additions:** STUDIO-PERFORMANCE is now after REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS and before T12-ADVANCED. The retrospective rule is in the backlog; the first one comes after STORE-REDESIGN or at round 200.
- **New signal for the next retrospective:** the site-wide outline probably doubles the focus ring on 53 other components. That is not fixed in this round.
- **Round-190 follow-ups:** no unit test currently stops the loader-overlay fix from being reverted. One will be added when the next round owns that file, and the regression round will check it in the browser. ArrowDown scrolling the page under the loader is filed as a deferred Low. The reviewer's note about page transitions is recorded only as a signal.
- **Next round:** round 192 is the regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-10-27; otherwise it is STORE-2.
- **Advisor:** available and consulted three times. Its last review found that the focus ring would cut through the thumb on three faders, so I let those inputs grow in height and added a check that the ring never crosses the thumb.
- **Ableton:** I consulted no Ableton source for this visual bug, and the task says so.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-190.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json (version 176)
- feature-status.md
- tasks/round-190.md (archived copy of the round-190 task)
- b-round-190/ (backups, the browser probe and screenshots)
